translations.web: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
translations.bsb: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.
translations.kjv: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
translations.asv: and the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be inclosed in gold in their settings.
